given: a stock record whose serial is populated
then: the serial field shows that record's serial value
architectural_notes: E2E: serial counterpart to AC3's value binding, flowing from stock_records.serial_number through app/repositories -> app/services -> boundary JSON -> the SPA stock-view component. Owner module is the SPA stock-view component bound to the boundary's serial_number field. Realizes the design by verifying the read path surfaces the persisted serial value in its own labelled field, independent of the batch binding; presentation only, no logic in the boundary.

independence.rationale: This is the serial counterpart to AC3's batch outcome. Breaking only the serial field's value binding fails this while the batch value (AC3) stays green, so the two are independently breakable.
